title: Titanium Pacemaker Enclosure
alloyReason: Grade 2 CP-Ti (UNS R50400) is selected for Titanium Pacemaker Enclosure where formability and corrosion resistance are prioritized over absolute strength. With 40% elongation and excellent weldability, Grade 2 CP-Ti forms a stable TiO₂ passive film that provides immunity to pitting in chloride environments up to 260°C. Its 345 MPa yield strength with 30% elongation makes it ideal for Permanent pacemaker outer hermetic enclosure requiring cold forming or bending without cracking. This rationale is driven by permanent pacemaker outer hermetic enclosure and service environment demands.
process: CNC swiss turning for implantable device geometry
Ultrasonic clean Class 10k with SPC sampling
surfaceTreatment: Electropolishing + passivation per ASTM F86 (20-30% HNO3, 30min @50C) achieving Ra <0.2um for implant-grade finish — tailored for permanent pacemaker outer application
inspection: Mech test ASTM per std (permanent pacemaker verified)
commonFailures: Fe contamination from machining - requires acid passivation 20-30% HNO3, 30min @50C per ASTM F86 — critical for permanent pacemaker outer performance

faq.q: Is Titanium Pacemaker Enclosure MRI-safe or MRI-conditional?
faq.a: Grade 2 CP-Ti is non-ferromagnetic (magnetic susceptibility 1.00005 × 10⁻⁶ cgs) and generates negligible MRI artifact compared to 316L stainless steel. Titanium Pacemaker Enclosure is classified as MR-Conditional under ASTM F2052/F2213 testing at 1.5T and 3.0T field strengths. Specific absorption rates remain within safe limits for permanent pacemaker outer configurations.

faq.q: What is the typical lead time for Titanium Pacemaker Enclosure orders?
faq.a: Standard lead time for Titanium Pacemaker Enclosure is 15-25 business days depending on quantity and complexity. Rush orders (3-5 working days) are available for prototype evaluation. Sample evaluation (1-5 units) can be expedited to 5-7 business days. Volume pricing is available for production quantities above 100 units.

faq.q: What material certifications are provided with Titanium Pacemaker Enclosure?
faq.a: Each Titanium Pacemaker Enclosure shipment includes EN 10204 Type 3.1 mill test certificate with chemical analysis, mechanical properties, and heat identification. Dimensional inspection reports and Certificate of Conformance (CoC) are standard. First Article Inspection Reports (FAIR) per AS9102 are available on request for permanent pacemaker outer.
